name: Slow Burn
blurb: Flirty dares, sensual truths, tension you can feel.

cards.text: Describe our best kiss in detail. The other person is not allowed to interrupt until you're finished.
Kiss them like you mean it, then pull away first. That's the whole dare.
cards.soften: Three short kisses with eye contact between each.

cards.text: Trace their collarbone with one fingertip, unhurried.
cards.speak: While you do, say what you were thinking the first time you saw them tonight.
cards.soften: Trace their forearm instead.

cards.text: What do you think about when we're apart? Be specific — moments, not summaries.
Mutual gaze, one minute, zero words. Whoever speaks first pays a kiss toll.
cards.soften: Thirty seconds, eyes allowed to close.

cards.text: Slow dance with no music. Pick the tempo with your bodies, not your words.
cards.speak: Halfway through, whisper what you want tonight — the feeling, not the plan.
cards.soften: Just sway, no dare beyond that.

cards.text: When was the last time you felt genuinely wanted by me? What was I doing right?
Kiss their neck for 30 slow seconds.
cards.speak: While you do, tell them the moment this week you were proudest of them.
cards.soften: Forehead kiss plus the compliment.

cards.text: Trade answers: what makes you feel desired — being chased, being chosen, being claimed, or something else entirely?
Silence and skin: two minutes of touch with no talking. Describe nothing, ask nothing, just pay attention.
cards.soften: One minute, hands only above the shoulder.

cards.text: Describe out loud what you feel happening in your own body while they rest a hand on your heart. Full sentences. They just listen.
cards.speak: They repeat back the last sentence you said before you stop.
cards.soften: Describe one sensation, one sentence.

cards.text: Finish this: 'the moment I knew I was done for was…' Fill in every detail you remember.
Kiss down their neck, unhurried. Wherever you pause, say one true thing before moving on.
cards.soften: Three slow kisses, three true things.

cards.text: What's something you've been curious about with me but never brought up? Curiosity is the only price of admission.
Describe each other's body for sixty seconds using only words you'd want said about your soul.
cards.soften: One sentence each, whispered.

cards.text: Trace their lips with one finger. Their eyes stay closed.
cards.speak: Describe what you want to do next — starting every sentence with 'I want'. You don't have to do it yet.
cards.soften: Trace their hand instead. Same rule.

cards.text: Tell them about the last time a simple look from them made the air feel heavier.
What is one quiet way they pull you in that still catches you off guard?
Share a memory of a kiss that lingered longer than it needed to and why it stayed with you.
Describe the kind of tension you most want to build between you tonight.
When did you most recently feel that slow pull of wanting them closer without rushing?
What small detail about the way they kiss or lean in makes you want to stay right there?
Invite a sixty-second gaze hold: sit close, eyes open, no speaking, just the quiet pull between you.
cards.soften: Hold soft eye contact for twenty seconds while smiling.

cards.text: Offer to sync your breathing with theirs for one full minute while your foreheads rest together.
cards.soften: Share a few slow breaths while sitting close.

cards.text: Invite silence-with-touch: no words for ninety seconds while you keep continuous light contact — hands, arms, or resting close.
cards.soften: Stay quietly connected with a hand hold for thirty seconds.

cards.text: Lean in and offer a slow kiss that lasts at least ten seconds, then stay close enough to share breath afterward.
cards.speak: I could stay right here with you all night.
cards.soften: Give a soft, unhurried kiss and linger nearby.

cards.text: Invite them into a near-kiss: hold the space just before your lips meet for twenty seconds before closing the distance.
cards.speak: I've been thinking about this exact moment.
cards.soften: Pause close for a few breaths before a gentle kiss.

cards.text: Offer a trail of three unhurried kisses along their jaw or neck while keeping your hands soft and still.
cards.speak: Every time I get this close I want to linger longer.
cards.soften: Place one slow kiss on their cheek and stay near.

cards.text: Pull them into a quiet embrace and stay there long enough for the rest of the room to fade, breathing together.
cards.speak: This is my favorite place to be.
cards.soften: Share a warm, unhurried hug.

cards.text: Invite a kissing game: trade slow kisses, but each one must last a little longer than the last, up to five total.
cards.soften: Share three soft kisses with a short pause between each.

cards.text: Offer to hold their face gently while you kiss them like you have all the time in the world.
cards.speak: I never get tired of the way you feel this close.
cards.soften: Cup their face for a single soft kiss.

cards.text: Invite the slowest, deepest kiss you can manage while pressing as close as clothing allows, letting the heat build without rushing past it.
cards.speak: I want you to feel how much I've been holding back.
cards.soften: Share a long, close kiss while holding them firmly.

cards.text: Together, keep continuous eye contact and light touch for a full minute without speaking, noticing every small shift in the other.
cards.soften: Hold hands and soft eye contact for twenty seconds.

cards.text: Sync your breathing while standing or sitting close, foreheads touching, for ninety seconds. Let the quiet do the work.
cards.soften: Share ten slow breaths together while close.

cards.text: Create a shared tension window: sit close enough to kiss but agree not to for two full minutes, letting the want build in the space between you.
cards.soften: Hold the almost-kiss distance for thirty seconds.

cards.text: Trade five slow kisses, alternating who leads, and after the last one stay pressed close in silence for thirty seconds.
cards.soften: Share three soft kisses and a short quiet hold.

cards.text: Talk about the kind of kiss that makes time feel slower for both of you.
Share what builds the best tension between you — distance, nearness, or the almost-touch.
Discuss a quiet moment of attraction from the past week that neither of you mentioned at the time.
What small, specific thing do you both want more of when the night turns slow and close?
